posts.body:
So I'm making my first RPG Maker XP game and I wanted to make a system kinda like in God of War, where instead of regular leveling player collects items that increase stats. I want to make it so when you use an item you get a choice like "Which character should use this item?". Here's where I need help - I know how to make those items via common events but I have no idea how to make the choice. At first there is gonna be only one character in a party and 3 more will join them later in game. Can I somehow make it so that the game knows what characters are in a party and gives the player choice between them?
Edit:
Turns out I'm way dumber than I thought and I don't even need to use common events, there's literally a parameter change setting in item editing. So... I guess the problem is solved? My first post here, idk what should I do in that case
